pairs.evidence: scripts/check-guide-content.mjs:160 Locale parity compares only block types, allowing changed item counts and semantic labels to pass despite the required structural invariance.

techniques.evidence: src/components/guide/blocks/StepWizard.tsx:33 Shared parsing is realized, but StepWizard renders raw strings while page.tsx:34 strips inline markup for JSON-LD; real steps contain links and backticks, so machine text differs from visible text.

src/components/guide/guide-markdown/parseGuide.ts:183 Unknown directives are dropped with gated diagnostics, but feature blocks accept arbitrary authored color attributes, passed into FeatureHighlight's inline styles; the standard explicitly rejects appearance pass-through.

src/components/guide/guide-markdown/parseGuide.ts:261 The guard is case-insensitive, but its literals duplicate CalloutVariant, standalone directive entries, and both renderer style tables; those tables use Record<string, ...> rather than deriving exhaustiveness from one shared enumeration.

src/components/guide/guide-markdown/parseGuide.ts:193 Separate block grammars exist, but checklist continuation prose becomes a new item instead of folding into the preceding item; an in-memory probe confirmed two items and zero diagnostics after wrapping one item.

scripts/check-guide-content.mjs:180 The gate reads actual locale bodies, but compares only node-type sequences and permits baselined divergence; removing a step or changing warning to info leaves that comparison unchanged, and separate fidelity tests cover outlines and link targets rather than item counts and enum positions.
